thread:
alex: Quick sync — we need alignment on launch acceptance for the slimline pilot. Items: SLA targets, minimal docs, support/oncall, monitoring hooks, and a simple pricing path. Who's up for quick ownership breakdown?

marta: I can own the docs + examples for dev onboarding. Thinking a 2-page quickstart + 1 troubleshooting runbook.

kevin: SLA question first — do we aim for 99.9% or 99.95% for hosted pilot? Dedicated customers might expect higher. Ops impact?

sasha: Ops POV: 99.95 requires extra redundancy and ~2x infra cost at nontrivial scale. For pilot, 99.9 is reasonable. Need concrete alerting/runbooks either way.

jamal: Pricing POV: for pilot I'd recommend pay-as-you-go with a small committed discount option. Need unit price per 1k tokens and an overage cap for early customers.

alex: @sasha can you quantify the infra delta in a quick note? we might keep public SLA at 99.9 and offer SLA upgrade for paid tiers.

sasha: Will do. Quick note: at our current config, moving to N+1 across regions + warm standby increases baseline infra cost ~85-110% depending on model memory. I'll post numbers.

marta: Docs: plan outline — Quickstart (auth, sample call, streaming), Troubleshooting (common 5xx, auth issues), Rollout notes (fallback models, rate limits). I can draft by EOD+3.

kevin: For customer comms: need clear wording. Suggest: "Pilot SLA: 99.9% uptime for hosted API. Dedicated customers can opt into higher SLAs with reserved capacity." Thoughts?

jamal: Sounds fine. I'll run two pricing scenarios: (A) pure usage: base price X per 1k tokens, (B) committed burst: 3-month commit at 20% discount + minimum monthly. Need expected token throughput to model revenue hit.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke tests passed in staging at 2026-03-22T09:12Z. p95=160ms, error_rate=0.3%, kv_cache_hit=22%.

alex: Good signal. Action items: @sasha runbook + alert thresholds (due EOD+2), @marta docs draft (EOD+3), @jamal pricing scenarios (EOD+2), @kevin SLA wording + customer comms draft (EOD+1).

marta: noted. I'll add a short sample curl and a minimal troubleshooting checklist.

sasha: Draft alert rules I'll add to the runbook: 
- alert if error_rate > 0.5% for 5m
- alert if p95_latency > 500ms for 3m
- alert if token_cost_per_minute spikes > 40% baseline for 10m
I'll drop YAML snippets for SLOs.

kevin: For legal/comms we should avoid promising instant rollback SLAs. Phrase: "We maintain targeted uptime and have documented escalation paths."

jamal: Also recommend a protective usage credit for pilot customers in the contract — e.g., first 1M tokens free credit to test. Helps adoption.

alex: Good suggestion. One more operational ask: we need monitoring dashboards ready (p50/p95/p99, errors, token spend). @sasha can you pair with observability to get a dashboard template?

sasha: Yes. Will coordinate and post a link to the dashboard template once observability wires the panels.

marta: I'll include a "what to expect" section for customers: latency expectations, retry guidance, and how to contact support.

kevin: Tentative launch acceptance for pilot: docs in place, runbook + alerts, baseline dashboard, pricing scenarios, and a brief SLA statement. If any of these missing, no go.

alex: Agree. Let's keep this light — pilot scope should be minimal but defensible. We'll reconvene in 48h to confirm. :thumbsup:

sasha: ack :thumbsup:

jamal: ack — I'll post numbers (cost diffs + pricing models) tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary tomorrow 03/23 02:00 UTC.

marta: thanks — I'll sync examples to the canary.

kevin: I'll draft the customer-facing SLA paragraph and share in #product-drafts for review.

alex: Thanks all — will aggregate action items and drop a short checklist in the thread.

marta: small Q — do we need localized support docs (EN only for pilot) or multi-locale?

kevin: EN-only for pilot, we can add i18n in GA roadmap.

alex: Closing note: prioritize what prevents safe operation (alerts/runbook) over marketing polish. We'll expand docs and pricing after pilot metrics.

sasha: Copy, focusing on the runbooks and alerts first.

jamal: Copy, will prioritize the two pricing scenarios.

kevin: Thanks team.

alex: Thread end — will post checklist shortly.
